'''Henre Haslin''' was Master of the Swords in the [[Queen's Guard]] under [[Queen Morgase]].

== Appearance ==
He has a big red nose with only a small amount of white hair.

== History ==
Along with [[Gareth Bryne]], Haslin notably helped train [[Galadedrid Damodred|Galad]] as Galad recalls prior to his duel with [[Eamon Valda]].{{ref/book|11|Prologue}}

== Activities ==
He was dismissed by [[Lord Gaebril]] during the Gaebril's remaking of the army.  Haslin was dismissed from his position training recruits allegedly due to his age but was really dismissed because of his loyalty to Morgase.  

He was eventually recruited by [[Rand al'Thor]] to train the [[Asha'man]] in swordplay.  He was briefly sent away by [[Mazrim Taim]], who saw no value in weapons aside from the Power, until Rand commanded Taim to bring him back.{{ref/book|6|11}}
